slots.notes: Logged-in user's avatar in the navbar: a single w-10 h-10 circular pill button (object-cover). Native placeholder is a Pexels headshot (pexels-photo-1239291, w=80); brand supplies one square headshot cropped to a circle.

Hero portrait filling Card 1 (Profile Photo Card): w-full h-full object-cover object-top, rounded-3xl, aspect-[4/3] on mobile and fills the parent cell on desktop. Bottom 35% is overlaid by a blur+dark-gradient mask carrying white name/role/salary text, so it must read as a darkenable person/team photo with the subject in the upper two-thirds. Native placeholder is a Pexels portrait (pexels-photo-1130626, w=600).

Small product/device thumbnail inside the expanded 'Hardware' accordion row on Card 5: a w-12 h-10 rounded-lg image (object-cover) next to 'ThinkPad Pro / Edition X1' text. Native placeholder is a Pexels device shot (pexels-photo.jpg, w=120).

Overlapping attendee avatar stack on the two Calendar Card events (Card 6): each w-6 h-6 rounded-full object-cover with a 2px white border, overlapping at marginLeft -6px. The dark event shows 3, the white event shows 2 (drawn from the same pool). Native placeholders are three Pexels headshots (415829, 1681010, 774909, w=60); brand supplies a small pool of square headshots cropped to circles.

lucide-react monochrome line-icon set drawn at 10-16px and tinted by the surrounding text color (mostly #898989 muted, white inside the dark Pending-Actions panel, #303030 on light controls). Covers nav/utility glyphs (Settings, Bell, Menu, X, ArrowUpRight, MoreVertical, ChevronDown/Up), stat badges (Users, Monitor), timer controls (Play, Pause, RotateCcw), task-row marks (Monitor, Users, MessageSquare, Pencil, Link, Check). Code-rendered, not asset files; reskin tints via currentColor.

Sofia Pro (the 'Sofia Pro Medium' / 'Sofia Pro Regular' faces) loaded from an external onlinewebfonts.com stylesheet in index.html; a single family drives every string — the 3xl-5xl greeting and stat numbers, all card titles and labels, and the Recharts XAxis tick labels (fontFamily 'Sofia Pro Regular', 11px). Tailwind's sans is set to Century Gothic only as a fallback. Pick a clean geometric sans; the large light-weight numerics are font-metric-sensitive.

mechanic: A fixed-height non-scrolling responsive glass-card dashboard (4x2 CSS grid on desktop, 2-col tablet, single-column mobile stack) layered z-10 over a fullscreen fixed SVG background whose yellow blob is softened by a heavy Gaussian blur, with a few self-contained accents: a Recharts bar chart highlighting Friday with a yellow pill tooltip, a hand-drawn 60-tick SVG focus-timer ring filled to 70%, and an expand/collapse accordion (Hardware open by default).
techDelivery: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS 3 component spec; recharts 3.8 for the bar chart, lucide-react 0.344 icons, Sofia Pro via an external onlinewebfonts.com stylesheet, optional @supabase/supabase-js wiring.
reskinNotes: Color tokens are not centralized: the palette (#FFD85F yellow, #303030 dark, #898989 grey, #E3E5E6 base) is repeated as Tailwind arbitrary-value classes and inline styles throughout markup, and the fixed SVG background hardcodes #E3E5E6 and #FFD85F inside an inline blob <path> + Gaussian-blur filter that must be edited in code to reskin. The focus-timer ring (180x180 SVG, 60 procedurally drawn ticks, 70% yellow arc) and the welcome-row hatched 'Sprint cycle' segment (a repeating-linear-gradient with #e5e5e5/#f5f5f5/#ddd) are generative inline SVG/CSS, not assets. Every string — greeting 'Good morning, Kasven', the 8 nav labels, all stat numbers, task list (5 rows with dates/done-state/icons), accordion titles, calendar month/day/time labels and both event cards — is hardcoded in JSX with no data source. The Recharts dataset (S/M/T/W/T/F/S hour values) and the Friday-only tooltip are baked in. Layout is font-metric-dependent: the 3xl-5xl light-weight greeting and stat numerals, the proportional segment-bar flex ratios (15/15/60/10), and the absolutely-positioned calendar events (percent left/right + pixel top/height) are tuned to Sofia Pro and to the short placeholder copy, so longer reskin strings can overflow or reflow.
